column4: Function
column5: Description
column6: Acceptance Criteria

column4: Register a new Creator account using email and password.
column5:
Given a new user wants to create content, 
When they open the Sign Up page and submit their details, 
Then a new Creator account is created and they are logged in.
column6:
- Email must be unique with real-time validation feedback. 
- Password must be at least 8 characters with strength indicator. 
- Clear error messages for validation failures.
- Success message with next steps guidance.
- On success, user is redirected to onboarding flow.

column4: Login to a Creator account.
column5:
Given a registered Creator wants to access their account, 
When they submit the correct credentials on the Login page, 
Then they are authenticated and redirected to their dashboard.
column6:
- Clear error messages for incorrect credentials with retry guidance. 
- Loading state during authentication process.
- Remember me functionality with secure token storage.
- On success, user is redirected to dashboard with welcome message.

column4: View list of all owned quiz sets on a dashboard.
column5:
Given a Creator is logged in, 
When they open their "My Quizzes" dashboard, 
Then a list of all their quiz sets is displayed as interactive cards.
column6:
- Prominent "Create New Quiz" button with clear visual hierarchy. 
- Each card shows Title, Image, question count, last modified date, and quick actions.
- Empty state with helpful guidance for first-time users.
- Search and filter functionality for large collections.
- Responsive grid layout that works on mobile devices.

column4: Create a new quiz set (Title, Description, Cover Image).
column5:
Given a Creator is on their dashboard, 
When they click "Create New Quiz" and fill in the title/description, 
Then a new quiz set is created and they are taken to the editor.
column6:
- Step-by-step wizard with progress indicator. 
- Title is a required field with character count and validation.
- Optional description with rich text formatting.
- Image upload with drag-and-drop functionality and preview.
- Auto-save functionality to prevent data loss.
- On save, redirects to the "Edit Quiz" page with success message.

column4: Update an existing quiz set's information.
column5:
Given a Creator is editing a quiz set, 
When they change the title or description and save, 
Then the quiz set's information is updated in the database.
column6: - Changes are reflected immediately upon returning to the dashboard.

column4: Delete a quiz set.
column5:
Given a Creator is on their dashboard, 
When they select "Delete" for a quiz and confirm, 
Then the quiz set and all its associated questions are permanently removed.
column6:
- A confirmation modal must be shown before deleting. 
- The quiz card is removed from the UI.

column4: View all questions within a specific quiz set.
column5:
Given a Creator is in the "Edit Quiz" page,
When the page loads, 
Then a list of all questions for that quiz is displayed, allowing for selection and reordering.
column6:
- Split-screen layout with question list on left and editor on right. 
- Drag-and-drop reordering with visual feedback and auto-save.
- Question preview cards with type icons and difficulty indicators.
- Selecting a question highlights it and shows details in the editor form.
- Empty state with quick-add options for first question.
- Keyboard shortcuts for common actions (Ctrl+N for new question).

column4: Add a new question (Multiple Choice, True/False).
column5:
Given a Creator is in the editor, 
When they click "Add Question" and select "Multiple Choice" or "True/False", 
Then a form appears for them to create and save the new question.
column6:
- Question type selector with visual icons and descriptions. 
- Multiple Choice: minimum 2 answers, maximum 6, with add/remove buttons.
- True/False: simplified interface with toggle buttons.
- Real-time validation with helpful error messages.
- Auto-save draft functionality every 30 seconds.
- Preview mode to test question appearance.

column4: Update an existing question.
column5:
Given a Creator selects an existing question in the editor, 
When they modify its content, answers, or time limit and save, 
Then the question is updated.
column6: - The changes are saved without a full page reload.

column4: Delete a question.
column5:
Given a Creator is in the editor, 
When they click the delete icon on a question and confirm, 
Then the question is removed from the quiz set.
column6:
- A confirmation prompt is required. 
- The question is removed from the list UI.

column4: Upload media (image) for a question.
column5:
Given a Creator is editing a question, 
When they use the "Upload Image" option, 
Then they can select an image file which is then associated with that question.
column6:
- Supports common image formats (JPG, PNG). 
- A preview of the uploaded image is shown.

column4: Generate a unique 6-digit PIN for a new game session.
column5:
Given a Host starts a game session, 
When the server processes the request,
Then a unique 6-digit PIN is generated and associated with the session.
column6:
- Large, prominent PIN display with copy-to-clipboard functionality. 
- PIN must not conflict with other active sessions.
- Visual countdown timer showing session expiration (30 minutes).
- QR code generation for easy mobile access.
- Share buttons for social media and messaging apps.

column4: Allow anonymous players to join using PIN and a unique nickname.
column5:
Given a Player is on the homepage, 
When they enter a valid Game PIN and a unique nickname, 
Then they are successfully added to the game lobby.
column6:
- Clean, minimal join form with clear instructions. 
- Real-time PIN validation with helpful error messages.
- Nickname suggestions and availability checking.
- Loading states and success animations.
- Accessibility support with screen reader compatibility.

column4: Host can view the list of joined players.
column5:
Given a Host is in the lobby, 
When new players join, 
Then the list of player nicknames on the Host's screen updates in real-time.
column6:
- Animated player avatars with smooth join animations. 
- Player count badge with live updates.
- Scrollable list with virtual scrolling for large groups.
- Player status indicators (ready, not ready).
- Bulk actions (kick multiple, send message to all).

column4: Host can start the game from the lobby.
column5:
Given a Host is in the lobby with at least one player, 
When they click the "Start Game" button, 
Then the game state changes and the first question is sent to all clients.
column6:
- Large, prominent "Start Game" button with countdown animation. 
- Button disabled state with helpful tooltip when no players.
- Pre-game checklist (minimum players, quiz validation).
- Smooth transition animation to game interface.
- Progress indicator showing game setup status.

column4: Host can trigger the next question.
column5:
Given a Host is viewing the results of a question, 
When they click "Next Question", 
Then the server sends the next question in the sequence to all clients.
column6:
- The button should be clearly labeled. 
- The system correctly moves to the next question or the final results screen if it's the last question.

column4: Player's screen displays options corresponding to the host's screen.
column5:
Given a Host has triggered a new question, 
When a Player's device receives the event, 
Then their screen updates to show the appropriate interface for answering (buttons, etc.).
column6: - The interface must be responsive and work on mobile devices.

column4: Player can submit their answer.
column5:
Given a Player is viewing a question,
When they click their chosen answer within the time limit, 
Then their selection is sent to the server for processing.
column6: - After submitting, the interface should be disabled to prevent changing the answer.

column4: Server calculates score based on correctness and time.
column5:
Given a Player submits an answer, 
When the server receives it, 
Then it calculates the score based on correctness and (if enabled) response time.
column6:
- The scoring formula is correctly applied. 
- Players who don't answer receive 0 points.

column4: Display a simple leaderboard (Top 5) after each question.
column5:
Given the time for a question has ended, 
When the server processes the results, 
Then it sends an updated Top 5 leaderboard to be displayed on all screens.
column6: - The leaderboard is sorted correctly by score.

column4: Display the final winner podium.
column5:
Given the last question has been answered, 
When the server finalizes the scores, 
Then a final podium screen displaying the Top 3 winners is shown.
column6: - The podium correctly displays 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place.

column4: Add/Update question type: Matching (up to 5 pairs).
column5:
Given a Creator is in the editor, 
When they add a "Matching" question, 
Then they can define up to 5 pairs of items and save the question.
column6:
- The form must allow creating 2 to 5 pairs. 
- The saved data structure correctly represents the pairs.

column4: Add/Update question type: Ordering (up to 6 items).
column5:
Given a Creator is in the editor, 
When they add an "Ordering" question, 
Then they can define up to 6 items and set their correct sequence.
column6:
- The form must allow creating 3 to 6 items. 
- The drag-and-drop interface for ordering must be intuitive.

column4: Add/Update question type: Video Question (timestamp-based).
column5:
Given a Creator is in the editor, 
When they add a "Video Question", 
Then they can upload a video (max 2 minutes) and select a specific timestamp to display the question during playback.
column6:
- Video must be max 2 minutes in length. 
- Video must be in supported formats (MP4, WebM). 
- Each video counts as 1 question.

column4: Upload video file for Video Question.
column5:
Given a Creator is creating a Video Question, 
When they use the "Upload Video" option, 
Then they can select a video file (max 2 minutes) which is associated with that question.
column6:
- Supports common video formats (MP4, WebM). 
- Enforces 2-minute maximum duration limit. 
- Shows file size and duration validation.

column4: Video preview with timestamp selection.
column5:
Given a Creator has uploaded a video for a Video Question, 
When they open the video editor, 
Then they can preview the video and select a specific timestamp to display the question.
column6:
- Video preview player with play/pause controls. 
- Timestamp selector with precise time input. 
- Preview shows exactly when the question will appear.

column4: Add "Duplicate Quiz Set" functionality.
column5:
Given a Creator is on their dashboard, 
When they select "Duplicate" for a quiz, 
Then a new quiz set is created with all the same questions and content.
column6: - The new quiz appears on the dashboard with "- Copy" in its title.

column4: Add a settings modal before hosting a game.
column5:
Given a Host selects "Host" for a quiz, 
When the action is triggered, Then
Then a settings modal is displayed before the lobby is created.
column6: - The modal contains all the specified setting options.

column4: Setting: Choose number of questions to play (e.g., 20 out of 50).
column5:
Given a Host is in the settings modal, 
When they enter a number 'N' in the "Number of Questions" field, 
Then the game will only use 'N' questions from the set.
column6: - The number 'N' must be valid (e.g., > 0 and <= total questions).

column4: Setting: Shuffle question order.
column5:
Given a Host is in the settings modal, 
When they check the "Shuffle Questions" box, 
Then the order of questions played will be randomized.
column6: - The order is different each time the game is played with this option.

column4: Setting: Enable/disable background music for the session.
column5:
Given a Host is in the settings modal, 
When they toggle the "Background Music" switch, 
Then this setting is saved for the session and sent to all players.
column6: - Players' clients correctly receive the setting and play/don't play music.

column4: Setting: Enable/disable leaderboard between questions.
column5:
Given a Host is in the settings modal, 
When they toggle the "Show Leaderboard" switch, 
Then the leaderboard will be skipped after each question.
column6: - The game flows directly from the question result to the next question.

column4: Setting: Enable/disable time-based scoring.
column5:
Given a Host is in the settings modal, 
When they toggle the "Time-based Scoring" switch, 
Then all correct answers will receive a fixed score.
column6: - The scoring logic correctly applies a fixed point value for correct answers.

column4: Implement a profanity filter for nicknames.
column5:
Given a Player tries to join with a nickname, 
When the server checks it, 
Then it rejects any nickname containing words from a predefined profanity list.
column6: - An appropriate error message is shown to the player.

column4: Host can "Kick" a player from the lobby.
column5:
Given a Host is in the lobby, 
When they click the "Kick" button next to a player's name, 
Then that player is removed from the game session.
column6: - The player is disconnected and sees a "You have been removed" message.

column4: Server-side state management to allow Host/Player to reconnect.
column5:
Given a Host or Player loses connection and then re-opens the game page, 
When the server identifies their session, 
Then it seamlessly reconnects them to the current state of the game.
column6: - The player's score is preserved. - The Host can continue to control the game.

column4: Generate a unique, shareable link for a quiz set.
column5:
Given a Creator is on their dashboard, 
When they select "Create Challenge" for a quiz, 
Then a unique, shareable URL is generated and displayed to them.
column6: - A "Copy Link" button is provided for convenience.

column4: Allow players to play solo anytime via the link.
column5:
Given a Player opens a challenge link, 
When they enter a nickname, 
Then they can play through the quiz questions at their own pace without a live host.
column6: - There is no time limit imposed by a host; each question uses its own predefined time limit.

column4: Display a separate leaderboard for each challenge link.
column5:
Given a Player completes a challenge, 
When their final score is calculated, 
Then it is saved and displayed on a persistent leaderboard specific to that challenge link.
column6: - The leaderboard updates correctly for each new participant.

column4: Player can mute/unmute all sounds on their own screen.
column5:
Given a Player is in a game (live or challenge), 
When they click the sound icon on their screen, 
Then all audio from the game is muted or unmuted only for them.
column6: - The setting persists across all screens within the game session.

column4: Host can view a report of a past game session.
column5:
Given a Creator is logged in, 
When they navigate to the "Reports" page, 
Then they can see a list of their past game sessions and select one to view its report.
column6: - The list is sorted by date, with the most recent session on top.

column4: Report includes a full, paginated leaderboard.
column5:
Given a Host is viewing a report, 
When the leaderboard is displayed, 
Then it is paginated to handle a large number of players gracefully.
column6: - The leaderboard shows controls to navigate between pages.

column4: Report includes a per-question correctness percentage chart.
column5:
Given a Host is viewing a report, 
When they scroll down, 
Then they see a bar chart for each question, visualizing the percentage of players who chose each option.
column6: - The correct answer bar is highlighted (e.g., in green).

column4: Add "Export to CSV" functionality for the report.
column5:
Given a Host is viewing a report, 
When they click the "Export to CSV" button, 
Then a CSV file containing the final leaderboard is downloaded.
column6: - The CSV file is correctly formatted with columns: Rank, Nickname, Score.

column4: Welcome tour for new creators.
column5:
Given a new Creator has registered, 
When they first log in, 
Then they see an interactive welcome tour highlighting key features.
column6:
- Step-by-step guided tour with tooltips and highlights. 
- Skip option for experienced users.
- Progress indicator showing tour completion.
- Key features: creating quiz, hosting game, viewing reports.

column4: Breadcrumb navigation throughout the application.
column5:
Given a Creator is navigating through the application, 
When they move between different sections, 
Then breadcrumb navigation shows their current location.
column6:
- Clear breadcrumb trail with clickable links. 
- Consistent navigation patterns across all pages.
- Mobile-responsive breadcrumb design.

column4: Keyboard navigation support.
column5:
Given a user wants to navigate using keyboard only, 
When they use Tab and arrow keys, 
Then all interactive elements are accessible via keyboard.
column6:
- Full keyboard navigation support. 
- Visible focus indicators.
- Skip links for main content.
- ARIA labels for screen readers.

column4: Loading states and skeleton screens.
column5:
Given a user is waiting for content to load, 
When pages or data are loading, 
Then appropriate loading states are displayed.
column6:
- Skeleton screens for content areas. 
- Progress indicators for file uploads.
- Smooth transitions between states.
- Error states with retry options.
